channel.title: Middle East AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Israel/Gaza, Iran, Syria, Lebanon and Iraq developments

item.title: Al-Sharaa: October 7 cannot dictate Israel's Syria policy, talks reached 90% agreement
item.description: Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa said Israel must change its security approach, revealed that direct talks have been underway for nearly a year, and insisted on returning to the 1974 border lines.

item.title: Iran outlines conditions for ending war with US through Qatar, including end to sanctions
item.description: According to Baghaei, the conditions and negotiation process did not represent a new development, but had already been communicated to the US earlier this week.

item.title: WATCH: Highway 60 reopens to traffic after bus catches fire, no injuries reported
item.description: An additional fire occured in Tirat Carmel later on Wednesday after an electric bicycle battery experienced thermal runaway, the Israel Fire and Rescue Authority said.

item.title: ‘So-called peace in Gaza is a spectacle’ should ‘shame us all,’ Macron claims in UNGA speech
item.description: Israeli leaders denounced French President Emmanuel Macron’s claims, calling him a liar and claiming he is taking “fake news to a new high.”

item.title: E1 settlements 'cannot be allowed,' Israeli action unjustified by Oct 7., Burnham says at UN
item.description: "We have acted by banning trade in goods with illegal settlements, recognizing that the Israeli occupation of the Palestinian territory is unlawful," Burnham said.

item.title: Olmert reveals intelligence breakthrough leading to Israel's 2007 strike on Syrian nuclear reactor
item.description: Former prime minister Ehud Olmert said the intelligence breakthrough that led to Israel's strikes on a Syrian nuclear reactor began with a young Mossad recruit in an interview with Channel 12.

item.title: ‘Repeating a lie doesn’t make it true’: Israel releases exposé of UN’s bias before General Assembly
item.description: The Ministry of Diaspora Affairs and Combating Antisemitism and the National Public Diplomacy Directorate in the Prime Minister's Office launched the campaign in an attempt to reveal the UN's lies.

item.title: Erdogan calls Gaza suffering 'most embarrassing concentration camp' in UNGA speech
item.description: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan told the UNGA that the UNSC must be reformed and called on Israel to end the war in Gaza.

item.title: Gaza GenoLIE: The campaign fighting “a modern blood libel”
item.description: A growing international coalition of more than 100 organizations says the accusation that Israel commits genocide in Gaza has become a weapon against Israel and Jews worldwide.

item.title: No. 1: Jared Kushner and Ivanka Trump: Remembering who brought the hostages home
item.description: Jared Kushner and Ivanka Trump helped achieve what few in Jerusalem thought possible, bringing every Israeli hostage home and reshaping the Middle East.

item.title: No. 3: Gadi Eisenkot: Israel’s next prime minister?
item.description: The former IDF chief has emerged as the leading opposition challenger to Netanyahu, offering voters a path to a post-Netanyahu Israel.

item.title: No. 4: Naftali Bennett: The former PM seeking a comeback to ‘repair Israel’
item.description: Since returning to politics, Bennett has shifted from his previous campaigns, taking a more liberal position while maintaining a strong right-wing stance on security.

item.title: No. 5: Ronald Lauder: Standing at the forefront of the fight against antisemitism
item.description: Lauder has never confined himself to quiet philanthropy - he continues to use his position to demand accountability from political leaders.

item.title: No. 2: Benjamin Netanyahu: Shaping Israel’s politics and global image for a generation
item.description: Netanyahu has become more than Israel’s prime minister for many. Abroad, for instance, he has become Israel’s symbol and the lightning rod for much of the hatred directed against the Jewish state.

item.title: IDF detains 14 HaBashan Pioneers attempting to infiltrate into Syria, establish settlements
item.description: The IDF detained 14 Israelis from the extremist Pioneers of Bashan after they crossed the Israel's Golan border into Syria, condemning the move and urging prosecution.

item.title: Colombia officially withdraws from South Africa's ICJ genocide case against Israel
item.description: Israeli ambassador to Colombia Vivien Aisen echoed the remarks, saying Colombia chose "the right side of history" and made "a brave and responsible decision that we deeply appreciate."

item.title: ‘We will cut off your fingers one by one’: Politician, activist Haddad receives death threats
item.description: Haddad, currently the second candidate on the People of Israel’s party list, is considered a hostile figure in Iran.

item.title: Netanyahu shames Mamdani for supporting Hamas, threatens to expose 'truth' ahead of UNGA visit
item.description: The comments follow a Monday CNN interview with Mamdani, where the mayor again called for Netanyahu’s arrest warrant, issued by the International Criminal Court (ICC), to be honored.

item.title: Gal Gadot's $3m. Genesis Prize initiative funds 24 Israeli mental health and trauma care NGOs
item.description: Recipients include Make-A-Wish Israel, United Hatzalah, and CareGivers Israel. The grants will support treatment, trauma counseling, caregiver training, and social work services.

item.title: Iraq suspends Iranian flights to Baghdad after US threatens sanctions on airport service providers
item.description: The suspension of flights will begin at midnight on Wednesday.
